@Haroenv I've got a similar issue after migrating from v6 to v7. Packages: ```json "react-instantsearch": "^7.4.1", "react-instantsearch-core": "^7.4.1", ``` Removed `@types` packages as per migration guide. In a component I've got: ```tsx import { Configure, InstantSearch, useInfiniteHits } from 'react-instantsearch' ``` (previously this was imported from `react-instantsearch-hooks-web`) render: ```tsx return (
{/* irrelevant code removed */}
) ``` ![Screenshot 2023-12-14 at 11 29 37](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/assets/5693633/d4ea2077-dc98-4cc0-b963-ff1fafc52222) As mentioned above - the props type is `PlainSearchParameters` which doesn't have `filters`. Although `PlainSearchParameters` extends `SearchOptions`, `SearchOptions` doesn't have anything for `filters` either as far as I can see but I could be misunderstanding the `PickForClient` code. Any ideas how to get this to work? I can see that the latest version (3.16.0) of `algoliasearch-helper` is being used.
